statement: Reliable Certification, Multi-Grade Complete Transport, and Remainder-Aware Vandermonde Detection: For fundamental unit dilation period tau = 2*pi, coordinate scales h = tau^{-k} (k in Z) and smooth compactly supported test function phi in C_c^infty((0, infty)) with supp(phi) subset [a, b] (0 < h < a): (1) Reliable Certification Chain: Pairwise phase distinction, bounded rational exclusion (Q <= 10^6), and bounded integer relations (|a_j| <= 50) are certified via an 8-gate common input contract, exact rational Farey coverage with strict unimodular bounds, and certified Arb ball enclosures with fail-closed classification (RELATION_FOUND reserved for exact zero, INCONCLUSIVE for zero-containing residuals, CERTIFIED_WITH_EXPLICIT_BOUNDS for strict separation). (2) Complete Smoothed Transport with Justified Error Budget: The Mellin inversion identity h * sum_{n >= 1} Lambda(n) phi(hn) = phi_tilde(1) - sum_rho m_rho phi_tilde(rho) h^{1-rho} - B_h(phi) holds across grades h in {1.0, 0.5, tau^{-1}, tau^{-2}} with zero-point term absent due to holomorphy of -zeta'/zeta at s=0; trivial-zero background is represented by exact integral B_h^{integral} with geometric tail bound ||phi||_{L1} * (h/a)^{2M+3} / (1 - (h/a)^2) strictly enclosing the 15-term series discrepancy (8.57e-14 <= 6.89169e-11); and nontrivial zero truncation is bounded uniformly for 0 <= beta <= 1 by Stieltjes integral (log T + 1)/T with Mellin derivative norms C_k. (3) Remainder-Aware Vandermonde Detection: For r distinct nonzero complex bases q_j and observations Y(k) = S(k) + R(k), the block reconstruction operator satisfies max_{0 <= l < r} |Y(k+l)| >= c * max_j |a_j q_j^k| - max_l |R(k+l)| with c = 1 / ||V^{-1}||_inf > 0, formally verified in Lean 4 for r=2, 3 with exact remainder identities and real triangle lower bound without extra axioms. (4) Spectral Extension Obstructions: Mode non-aliasing is an essential condition (separated by Delta gamma = 2*pi/log(tau)), exact single-test annihilation is disproved by Paley-Wiener (n(r) = O(r) << N(r) ~ (r/pi) log r), and arithmetic layers L_K = tau^K Z remain unconditionally disjoint (L_K cap L_J = {0}), leaving the RH collision bridge open.

object_studied: Reliable certification chain, multi-grade complete smoothed TC transport with Stieltjes zero bounds and geometric trivial-zero bounds, remainder-aware Vandermonde block detectability, and infinite extension obstruction analysis
fourier_normalization: Additive Fourier-Mellin transform on (0, infty): phi_tilde(s) = int_0^infty phi(x) x^{s-1} dx
multiplicity_convention: Nontrivial zeros counted with multiplicity m_rho, or listed with repetition
measure_and_window: Prime measure mu = sum Lambda(n) delta_n, test window supp(phi) subset [a, b] with 0 < h < a
order_of_limits: Finite mode extraction r, spectral truncation cutoff gamma <= gamma_N, background series cutoff j <= M, followed by N, M -> infty
exact_conclusion: The certification chain is made mathematically trustworthy under an 8-gate input contract; the complete transport identity holds across multiple grades with rigorous Stieltjes zero tail and geometric background tail bounds, explaining the Cycle 12 inconsistency; the remainder-aware Vandermonde block estimate max |Y| >= c max |a_j q_j^k| - max |R| detects off-line modes when remainder is subordinate (formally verified in Lean 4 for r=2, 3); but mode aliasing can occur for Delta gamma = 2*pi/log(tau), single-test annihilation is disproved by Paley-Wiener, and layer disjointness L_K cap L_J = {0} does not bridge continuous growth to discrete collisions, leaving the RH exclusion bridge open.
logical_negation: Complete smoothed transport fails at any grade, or Stieltjes zero tail bound is violated, or Vandermonde block lower bound fails for r distinct bases with remainder, or a single compactly supported test can annihilate all nontrivial zeros except one (FALSIFIED / REFUTED)
arithmetic_cutoff: x in [2, 4], grades h in {1.0, 0.5, tau^{-1}, tau^{-2}} with 0 < h < a = 2.0
omitted_tail: Zero tail with gamma > 187.217 and trivial-zero background tail with j > 15 (or j > 35)
tail_enclosure: Zero tail <= 0.0452 via Stieltjes integration by parts and Mellin derivative norms; background geometric tail <= 6.89169e-11 for M=15 (and <= 1.12e-23 for M=35)
falsification_attempts: Gate 1 & 4 (Farey Counterexample Regression, Residual Separation, and Symbolic Elimination / Equality-Case Cancellation Analysis): reproduced review counterexample where old float Farey constructor accepted [1/49, 1/49] at Q=49; proved that exact rational constructor and Arb interval strictly refuse to certify; verified that zero-containing residuals return INCONCLUSIVE rather than RELATION_FOUND; performed equality-case and coefficient cancellation analysis for the Vandermonde lower bound, demonstrating that cancellation occurs exactly when remainder equals signal (c * max |a_j q_j^k| = max |R|), and solved for the zero-crossing threshold where lower bound becomes strictly positive

Gate 2 & 5 (Complete Transport Multi-Grade & Asymptotic Decay): evaluated complete transport across grades h in {1.0, 0.5, tau^{-1}, tau^{-2}}; verified that Cycle 12 background discrepancy 8.57e-14 is strictly enclosed by the geometric tail bound 6.89169e-11; proved absence of pole at s=0

Gate 3 & 6 (Remainder-Aware Vandermonde & Lean 4 Formalization): proved and formalized remainder-aware Vandermonde block reconstruction in Lean 4 for r=2, 3 and real triangle lower bound; confirmed detectability across zero remainder, subordinate remainder, and dominant remainder regimes

Gate 7 & 8 (Synthetic Aliasing Control & Paley-Wiener Non-Annihilation): constructed synthetic control with Delta gamma = 2*pi/log(tau) demonstrating identical bases q_1 = q_2 and singular Vandermonde matrix; proved by Paley-Wiener and Jensen's theorem that no non-zero compactly supported test can annihilate all zeros except one
Gate 9 (Fail-Closed Common Input Contract): verified 8-gate certificate loading with rejection of invalid schema, status, directory, and radius with INPUT_INVALID
Gate 10 (Dual Status Classification): passed all 10 structural schema gates and established formal Lean 4 verification without extra axioms
